environment.description: Same Spring Boot service on ECS Fargate behind internal ALB. The task role has an IAM policy with fine-grained DynamoDB condition keys. The policy uses dynamodb:Attributes condition with ForAllValues:StringEquals to restrict UpdateItem to only the attributes 'displayName', 'email', 'avatarUrl', 'bio', and 'preferences'. Additionally, a dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition ensures the partition key matches ${aws:PrincipalTag/sub} (mapped from Cognito claims via IAM session tags). A separate permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:policy/UserServiceBoundary) is attached that explicitly denies dynamodb:UpdateItem when dynamodb:Attributes includes any of 'role', 'accountTier', 'creditBalance', 'isAdmin', 'permissions'. Note: the condition uses ForAnyValue:StringEquals on the deny, which triggers if ANY attribute in the request matches the restricted set.

config.session_tags: Cognito user pool configured with pre-token-generation Lambda that maps sub claim to aws:PrincipalTag/sub via STS session tags on AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
config.network: internal ALB, no WAF, no API Gateway
